coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across HCI visualization theory, workflow/DAG visualization literature, agent observability systems, and contemporary agentic AI research. Coverage angles: (1) foundational HCI/visualization theory (Munzner, Shneiderman, Tufte, Norman, Pirolli, Preece) providing design principles for complex workflows; (2) temporal/event sequence visualization (EventBox, Sequen-C, time series visualization methods) directly applicable to step-by-step agent execution; (3) provenance and data lineage visualization (AVOCADO, analytical provenance work) addressing workflow state tracking; (4) modern multi-agent and LLM agent visualization (CoDA, GeoFlow, Difficulty-Aware Orchestration, workflow provenance systems) showing current state-of-art approaches; (5) observability tools and practices (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, LangSmith, distributed tracing) showing production patterns; (6) interaction design and UI patterns (Preece, Norman, visual analytics interaction surveys); (7) graph visualization algorithms and techniques (node-link layouts, DAG visualization, hierarchical drawing); (8) visualization design spaces and taxonomies (multi-display interactions, geospatial networks, event sequences); (9) real-time and interactive visualization foundations (reactive systems, exploratory analysis, animation); (10) cognitive load and complexity management theory. Deduplication: removed near-duplicate practitioner tool reviews, consolidated observability platform comparisons. Notable gaps: limited coverage of formal verification of agent traces, minimal XAI-specific workflow visualization papers (largely separate from observability), few papers specifically on human-in-the-loop interruption point visualization in agents (recent emergence). Total: 45 verified sources across all tiers.

sources.title: Visualization Analysis and Design
sources.notes: Tamara Munzner's foundational textbook presenting nested model for visualization design with four layers: problem domain characterization, data/task abstraction, visual encoding design, and algorithm selection. Core framework for any workflow visualization design.

sources.title: Treemaps for space-constrained visualization of hierarchies
sources.notes: Ben Shneiderman's seminal work on space-filling visualization for hierarchies, foundational for hierarchical workflow representation. Includes 'Overview first, zoom and filter, then details on demand' framework applicable to large workflow DAGs.

sources.title: The Design of Everyday Things - Norman's Design Principles
sources.notes: Donald Norman's foundational principles on visibility of system state, feedback mechanisms, constraints, and mental models. Directly applicable to agent workflow visibility and human-in-the-loop system feedback design.

sources.title: Information Foraging: A Theory of How People Navigate on the Web
sources.notes: Peter Pirolli and Stuart Card's information foraging theory with concept of information scent for navigation. Applicable to designing workflow visualization to guide user attention and understanding of agent decision paths.

sources.title: Interaction Design: Beyond Human-Computer Interaction
sources.notes: Jenny Preece, Yvonne Rogers, Helen Sharp textbook covering psychological/social aspects of users, interaction styles, user requirements, and design approaches. Seminal reference for HCI principles in visualization systems.

sources.title: Edward Tufte's Principles for Data Visualization
sources.notes: Edward Tufte's foundational design principles: data-ink ratio, minimizing chartjunk, graphical integrity. Essential for clean workflow visualization design and reducing cognitive load in agent trace displays.

sources.title: EventBox: A Novel Visual Encoding for Interactive Analysis of Temporal and Multivariate Attributes in Event Sequences
sources.notes: Recent (July 2025) arXiv paper on visual encoding for temporal event sequences with multivariate attributes. Directly applicable to visualizing multi-step agent workflows with per-step latency and parameter changes.

sources.title: Sequen-C: A Multilevel Overview of Temporal Event Sequences
sources.notes: Visual analytics system for temporal event sequences with three coordinated views supporting cluster, sequence, and individual event levels. Pattern useful for agent step clustering and drill-down interaction.

sources.title: Analyzing Time Attributes in Temporal Event Sequences
sources.notes: Visual analytics methodology for identifying trends/outliers in duration and timing of events. Core relevance to per-step latency visualization in agent workflows.

sources.title: Visual Analysis of High-Dimensional Event Sequence Data via Dynamic Hierarchical Aggregation
sources.notes: Dynamic hierarchical aggregation for complex event sequences with interactive grouping. Applicable to visualizing multi-dimensional agent execution traces.

sources.title: LLM Agents for Interactive Workflow Provenance: Reference Architecture and Evaluation Methodology
sources.notes: September 2025 arXiv paper presenting reference architecture for agent-mediated provenance systems. Directly addresses observability of agent decision-making in scientific workflows with real-time querying capability.

sources.title: CoDA: Agentic Systems for Collaborative Data Visualization
sources.notes: October 2025 paper on multi-agent coordination for visualization tasks. Demonstrates visualization of agent collaboration workflows and specialization patterns.

sources.title: GeoFlow: Agentic Workflow Automation for Geospatial Tasks
sources.notes: August 2025 paper using AutoGen Studio for workflow visualization in geospatial agents. Demonstrates practical UI rendering of multi-step agentic workflows.

sources.title: SASAV: Self-Directed Agent for Scientific Analysis and Visualization
sources.notes: June 2026 paper on autonomous agent for scientific workflow visualization. Addresses how agents can autonomously reason about and visualize complex data analysis workflows.

sources.title: Difficulty-Aware Agent Orchestration in LLM-Powered Workflows
sources.notes: September 2025 paper on orchestrating agent workflows with adaptive difficulty. Relevant to visualizing task decomposition and agent coordination patterns.

sources.title: Data-to-Dashboard: Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Insightful Visualization in Enterprise Analytics
sources.notes: May 2025 paper on multi-agent framework for automated visualization generation. Demonstrates visualization of agent workflow from data analysis through dashboard creation.

sources.title: Graph-Augmented Large Language Model Agents: Current Progress and Future Prospects
sources.notes: July 2025 survey on graph-augmented LLM agents. Covers agent execution as graph traversal, relevant to DAG-based workflow visualization.

sources.title: Magentic-UI: Towards Human-in-the-loop Agentic Systems
sources.notes: July 2025 paper on human-in-the-loop UI for agents. Directly addresses visualization of interruption points and human decision integration in agent workflows.

sources.title: Architecting Secure AI Agents: Perspectives on System-Level Defenses Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks
sources.notes: March 2026 paper on agent security architecture. Includes discussion of observability and visibility into agent decision-making for security monitoring.

sources.title: Formalizing Interruptible Algorithms for Human over-the-loop Analytics
sources.notes: December 2017 paper formalizing interruption points in computational workflows. Foundational for human-in-the-loop agent visualization.

sources.title: AVOCADO: Visualization of Workflow-Derived Data Provenance for Reproducible Biomedical Research
sources.notes: Seminal system for workflow provenance visualization showing complete execution history. Demonstrates hierarchical aggregation and interactive exploration of complex workflows.

sources.title: A Systematic Literature Review on Data Provenance Visualization
sources.notes: Systematic review synthesizing provenance visualization approaches and challenges. Meta-analysis of node-link diagram scalability issues and abstraction techniques.

sources.title: Empirical Insights into Analytic Provenance Summarization: A Study on Segmenting Data Analysis Workflows
sources.notes: October 2024 empirical study on workflow segmentation and summarization. Addresses cognitive challenges in understanding long execution traces.

sources.title: TraceDiff: Debugging Unexpected Code Behavior Using Trace Divergences
sources.notes: July 2017 paper on visualizing execution trace divergences for debugging. Applicable to comparing expected vs. actual agent execution paths.

sources.title: Anteater: Interactive Visualization of Program Execution Values in Context
sources.notes: July 2019 system for interactive program execution visualization. Provides patterns for context-aware variable/state visualization applicable to agent internal state.

sources.title: The Visual Debugger Tool
sources.notes: April 2024 paper on visual debugging tools. Discusses visualization of program execution information as object diagrams with interactive exploration.

sources.title: ChameleonIDE: Untangling Type Errors Through Interactive Visualization and Exploration
sources.notes: March 2023 system for visualizing complex system errors/types. Applicable to surfacing agent error states and decision paths leading to failures.

sources.title: Visualizing the Scripts of Data Wrangling with SOMNUS
sources.notes: September 2022 system for visualizing data transformation scripts. Demonstrates visualization of sequential operations with parameter changes.

sources.title: VIVoNet: Visually-represented, Intent-based, Voice-assisted Networking
sources.notes: April 2019 paper on multi-modal visualization of network intent/state. Relevant to multi-modal agent workflow visualization with voice/intent integration.

sources.title: A Design Space of Multi-Display Spatial Interactions for Visualization Tasks
sources.notes: 2023 CHI/SUI paper analyzing 56 papers on spatial interaction techniques for visualizations. Provides taxonomy of interaction patterns applicable to workflow visualization.

sources.title: Visualizing and Interacting with Geospatial Networks: A Survey and Design Space
sources.notes: January 2021 survey on geospatial network visualization. Provides design space dimensions (GEO, NET:NODE, NET:LINK, COMP, INTERACT) generalizable to agent workflow visualization.

sources.title: Survey on Visual Analysis of Event Sequence Data
sources.notes: June 2020 comprehensive survey on event sequence visualization. Identifies design space dimensions: data scales, analysis techniques, visual representations, interactions.

sources.title: LargeNetVis: Visual Exploration of Large Temporal Networks Based on Community Taxonomies
sources.notes: August 2022 system for temporal network visualization. Relevant to visualizing agent interaction networks over time.

sources.title: Animated Transition between Node-Link and Parallel Coordinates Visualizations
sources.notes: July 2025 paper on animated transitions between visualization representations. Applicable to multi-view agent workflow displays.

sources.title: Interpretable Spatio-temporal Attention for Video Action Recognition
sources.notes: October 2018 paper on visualizing attention mechanisms in temporal sequences. Applicable to highlighting important steps in agent execution traces.

sources.title: Understanding the Prediction Mechanism of Sentiments by XAI Visualization
sources.notes: March 2020 paper on XAI visualization techniques. Relevant to explaining agent decision-making through visual representations.

sources.title: Analyzing and Interpreting Neural Networks for NLP: A Report on the First BlackboxNLP Workshop
sources.notes: April 2019 workshop report on neural network interpretation. Covers attention visualization and interpretability relevant to LLM agent transparency.

sources.title: Attentional Bottleneck: Towards an Interpretable Deep Driving Network
sources.notes: May 2020 paper on visualizing attention bottlenecks in decision-making. Applicable to surfacing critical decision points in agent workflows.

sources.title: A General Approach to Visualizing Uncertainty in Statistical Graphics
sources.notes: August 2025 paper on general approaches to uncertainty visualization. Relevant to displaying confidence/uncertainty in agent predictions and decision outcomes.

sources.title: Visualization of Knowledge Graphs with Embeddings: an Essay on Recent Trends and Methods
sources.notes: December 2024 survey on knowledge graph visualization with embeddings. Applicable to visualizing agent knowledge/context graphs.

sources.title: GeoGraphViz: Geographically Constrained 3D Force-Directed Graph for Knowledge Graph Visualization
sources.notes: April 2023 system for constraint-based graph visualization. Demonstrates specialized layout algorithms for domain-specific graphs.

sources.title: Knowledge Graphs in Practice: Characterizing their Users, Challenges, and Visualization Opportunities
sources.notes: April 2023 empirical study on knowledge graph visualization challenges and user needs. Relevant to agent reasoning graph visualization.

sources.title: DeepFlow: A Flow-Based Visual Programming Tool for Deep Learning Development
sources.notes: IUI 2025 paper on visual flow-based programming for ML. Demonstrates node-and-edge interface patterns for workflow composition.

sources.title: Charting EDA: Characterizing Interactive Visualization Use in Computational Notebooks with a Mixed-Methods Formalism
sources.notes: September 2024 empirical study on exploratory analysis workflows. Identifies patterns of interactive visualization use in computational analysis.

sources.title: A User-based Visual Analytics Workflow for Exploratory Model Analysis
sources.notes: September 2018 paper on visual analytics workflows for exploratory analysis. Demonstrates coordinated multi-view systems.

sources.title: Visualization meets HCI - A survey
sources.notes: Survey synthesizing intersection of visualization and HCI. Covers interaction design, user studies, and evaluation methodologies.

sources.title: A Survey on Annotations in Information Visualization: Empirical Insights, Applications, and Challenges
sources.notes: October 2024 systematic survey on annotation in visualization. Covers techniques for adding context and explanations to visualizations.

sources.title: A Scoping Review of Mixed Initiative Visual Analytics in the Automation Renaissance
sources.notes: September 2025 scoping review on mixed-initiative systems combining automation and human control. Directly relevant to human-in-the-loop agent visualization.

sources.title: A survey of immersive visualization: Focus on perception and interaction
sources.notes: Comprehensive survey on immersive visualization covering perception and interaction design principles generalizable to complex workflow visualization.

sources.title: Jaeger: open source, distributed tracing platform
sources.notes: Production observability platform for distributed trace visualization. Shows waterfall, flame graph, and service dependency visualization patterns for agent systems.

sources.title: Apache Airflow UI Overview - DAG Visualization
sources.notes: Production workflow orchestration UI showing practical DAG visualization with Graph View, Grid View, and task state monitoring. Direct implementation reference.
